---
name: Bug report
about: A wrong output, a crash, a failing test or a build problem
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**What happens, and what was expected.**

**How to reproduce.** Commands, inputs, and the commit (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`).

**Environment.** OS, compiler and version, CPU (`grep -m1 'model name' /proc/cpuinfo`), Python and NumPy versions.

**Output.** The relevant part of the log or of `resultats/<test>.json`.
